t: 克罗地亚克内斯·特皮米尔一世颁布了一项法规,这是在克罗地亚资料来源中首次书面提到克族人名的文件.
te: Croatian Knez Trpimir I issues a statute, a document with the first known written mention of the Croats name in Croatia…
dz: 克罗地亚克内斯·特皮米尔一世颁布了一项法规,这是在克罗地亚资料来源中首次书面提到克族人名的文件.
de: Croatian Knez Trpimir I issues a statute, a document with the first known written mention of the Croats name in Croatian sources.
